security_probation_001.evidence: Contract definitions are specified in DCA (legal) and DCA (local) for probationary contracts, DCB (legal) and DCB (local) for term contracts, and DCC (legal) and DCC (local) for continuing contracts.

security_nonrenewal_002.evidence: Board shall give written notice whether the Board proposes to renew or not to renew the contract not later than the 10th day before the last day of instruction in a school year.

security_seniority_definition_003.evidence: Seniority: Length of continuous active service in the District. An authorized leave of absence shall not be considered as an interruption in continuous active service.

security_rif_006.answer: Applies to contractual employees; triggered by Board-determined financial exigency or Superintendent-determined reorganization/program change. Implementation order: 1. Performance, 2. Certification/Licensure, 3. Reorganization/Program Change, 4. Seniority.
security_rif_006.evidence: A reduction in force may take place when the Board determines that financial exigency exists or the Superintendent determines that a reorganization or program change is required. In order of implementation, the criteria are: a. Performance... b. Certification/Licensure... c. Reorganization or Program Change; then, d. Seniority
